lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The primary horizontal row contains approximately five distinct, high-intensity centroids aligned with the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, forming a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: One prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light pixels above to a distinct shadow line below.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of smaller spots that are distinct from the larger, more widely spaced spots on the lateral flank.
